mode.title: Input mode
mode.description: Pick how channels are supplied. The two sections below correspond to this choice: only the section matching the selected mode is used, the other is ignored.
enumTitles: Channels - I provide the channel list

channels.title: Channels to look up
channels.description: Channel URLs, @handles or UC... ids, mixed freely. Only read when Input mode is Channels. The defaults are three channels that publish a contact address, so a run with untouched settings returns something.
channels.sectionCaption: Mode A: your own channel list
channels.sectionDescription: Used when Input mode is set to Channels. Ignored in Search mode.

searchQueries.title: Niche keywords to search
searchQueries.description: Each keyword is searched on YouTube and the resulting channels are scanned. Only read when Input mode is Search.
searchQueries.sectionCaption: Mode B: find channels by keyword
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used when Input mode is set to Search. Ignored in Channels mode.

maxChannelsPerQuery.title: Max channels per query
maxChannelsPerQuery.description: How many channels to take from each keyword. Search mode only.

maxChannels.title: Max channels (budget cap)
maxChannels.description: Hard ceiling on channels scanned in this run, so a broad keyword cannot run away.

minSubscribers.title: Minimum subscribers
minSubscribers.description: Skip channels below this size. Measured rates: 42% for 100K or more, 41% for 10K to 100K, and 21% below 10K, so a floor around 10,000 keeps a run away from the part of the range where addresses are scarce.

maxSubscribers.title: Maximum subscribers
maxSubscribers.description: Skip channels above this size, for targeting smaller creators.

scanVideoDescriptions.title: Also scan recent video descriptions
scanVideoDescriptions.description: Second source. Many creators put business contact in a video description rather than the About tab. Runs only when the About tab came up empty.

enrichFromLinkedSite.title: Also follow the channel's linked website
enrichFromLinkedSite.description: Third source. Follows the creator's own linked site and its contact page, resolving shortened links. Runs only when the first two came up empty.

includeChannelsWithoutEmail.title: Include channels with no email found
includeChannelsWithoutEmail.description: Adds the scanned-but-empty channels to the dataset, showing everything that was checked. These rows are never charged: billing applies only to channels where an address was found.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.sectionDescription: Defaults are fine for most runs.

country.title: Country (gl)
country.description: YouTube country code. Affects which channels search returns.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel channel scans. 5 is safe; 10 is faster and was measured without blocks.
